tools.name: search_motors
tools.description: Search current Mercury outboard inventory at Harris Boat Works (Ontario). Filter by horsepower, family (FourStroke, Pro XS, SeaPro, Racing), or stock status. Returns CAD pricing. Excludes Verado. inStock/stockQuantity are the normalized stock signal; availability is the catalog label. candidatePageT

tools.name: get_motor
tools.description: Fetch a single Mercury motor by id or slug, including pricing, decoded shaft/control/start facts, a specSource summary, normalized stock, and deep-link URL. Model-code fitment must be confirmed against the buyer’s transom before ordering; null means not stated. specSource flags database rigging pres

tools.name: estimate_trade_in
tools.description: Estimate the trade-in value (CAD) of a customer's current outboard using the live Harris Boat Works valuation. Horsepower may be omitted when the model infers a single validated HP.

tools.name: build_quote
tools.description: Build a read-only itemized CAD quote (motor + installation + propeller + trade-in + HST + financing tier) and return a deep-link URL the customer can open. Do not send contact details. A nonempty contact block is rejected. To store a lead, call submit_quote_lead with consent=true. Annotations are hi

tools.name: submit_quote_lead
tools.description: Submit a quote lead through the existing public quote API. Requires consent=true and a contact block with name and email. consent is explicit permission to store that contact with the calculated quote. This tool does not issue a consent receipt and does not change pricing, financing, or warranty. Co

tools.name: get_brand_rules
tools.description: Return Harris Boat Works' authoritative source-of-truth rules for any agent representing them: pricing currency, geography, no-Verado policy, financing minimums, deposit tiers, warranty.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search published public blog guides. Returns title, excerpt, canonical HTML URL, language, author, publication date, and Markdown URL. Omits hidden, draft, future, and the Traditional Chinese noindex pilot. Read-only. Does not accept a URL.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch one published public blog guide by catalog slug and language. Reads only the allowlisted same-site Markdown twin for that catalog item. Never pass a URL. Text is bounded and truncation is explicit. Read-only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent-mcp-server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_motor, build_quote, search_articles, get_article · Private data: search_motors, get_motor, build_quote, submit_quote_lead · Public sink: build_quote, submit_quote_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_motor, build_quote, search_articles, get_article · Private data: search_motors, get_motor, build_quote, submit_quote_lead · Public sink: build_quote, submit_quote_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_motors" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
